title: Critique Of The Colonial Economy
definition: The intellectual and economic dismantling of British imperial policies in India by 19th-century Indian nationalist thinkers who exposed the systematic exploitation, deindustrialization, and drain of wealth.
importanceInUpsc: Central pillar of Modern Indian History in General Studies Paper-1 (History of India) and General Studies Paper-2/3 (Economic development, colonial legacy), frequently tested in both Prelims via statements and Mains via analytical questions on the Drain Theory.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Critique Of The Colonial Economy.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: British expansion and consolidation in India
Land revenue systems (Permanent Settlement, Ryotwari, Mahalwari)
Charter Acts and free trade policy shifts
